name: Password Entry to Home
summary: The user submits valid credentials, the server establishes the session, and the client opens the application home view.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and the identified account is active with a valid password credential

inputs.name: Password
inputs.description: Valid password supplied through the test runner's secure settings.

serverInteraction.intent: Authenticate the identified user, establish the application session, and resolve the landing destination.

postconditions.expression: session-capability == authenticated-normal and the resolved home workspace is active
